title: Rollback compatibility for release 2.7
text:
# Compatibility prerequisites

Rollback from release 2.7 to 2.6 is permitted only if the publication schema migration has not completed.

Migration status must be checked using a live diagnostic tool; this document does not report the current migration state.

| Release | Target | Prerequisite |
| 2.7 | 2.6 | Publication schema migration incomplete |

This knowledge assistant cannot execute a rollback or establish live rollback eligibility.
